items.title: What Does Mastercard (MA) Signal With Its AI Payments And Biometric Push?
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE: MA) is pushing into AI-powered agentic commerce, biometric payments and secure digital identity across several new initiatives. The company is working with Google Pay in India on expanded biometric authentication for retail payments using device-level identity checks. Mastercard, Visa and Ant International are collaborating on a new Know-Your-Agent interoperability framework for AI agents in commerce workflows. items.title: How Far Could PayPal Stock Fall While Its Turnaround Plays Out?
items.summary: PayPal (PYPL) stock has fallen 14.2% over the past month to about $52, and it is still up 23.6% over three months. The bigger question is how far PayPal falls when a real market shock arrives, and how long it stays down. Its record says further than the market. Its turnaround asks for a long wait.
